ui.inventory.filter.grammar:
Show or Hide [# name] and below, indented, conditions and actions (the Spanish words also work).
Conditions: Rarity [op] Common/Magic/Rare/Epic/Legendary · Type espada lanza{ellipsis} · Base id · Class guerrero · ItemLevel < 10 · RelativeLevel <= -6 · Mods >= 3 · HasMod feroz <= 2 · Passive [Yes/No] · Material esquirla/cristal/prisma · Item Weapon/Material/Potion/Echo · Usable [Yes/No] · Weight Light/Medium/Heavy · Build [Base/Mod/Passive/Skill] or Build No (matches your build plan, {star}).
op: = != < <= > >=
Actions: Color R G B [A] · Border R G B · Background R G B [A] · Size 18{dash}45 · Sound alerta/campana/gema/legendario/material/suave · Icon circulo/estrella/triangulo/cuadrado/diamante [color].
The first matching rule wins. # starts a comment.
ui.inventory.filter.help:
Loot filter
CHECKBOXES: QUICK HIDE marks what you do not want to see on the map (by type, weight, use and level, Epics and Legendaries are never hidden; the {star} exception goes first and beats everything). YOUR RULES, in order from top to bottom: the checkbox turns a rule off without deleting it (it stays in the text with #OFF) and {cross} deletes it.
{star} MY BUILD: the Build condition matches what your plan asks for (BUILD tab); on the map it carries {star}.
PREVIEW: how sample items of your level would look.

ui.inventory.shop.forge_help:
Forge
UPGRADE: raises Power, Critical, Speed or Defense (5 each, total cap by rarity). Every 2 levels the passive goes up.
CONDENSE: combines weapon materials into a higher one (no randomness, cannot be undone).
FUSION: 1 TARGET {arrow} 2 ACTION {arrow} 3 PREVIEW {arrow} CONFIRM. Improves with materials, brings mods / passive / skills from another weapon (which is destroyed), removes mods or reforges the base into another type.
Pick from the list on the left; the action button is at the bottom right of the detail.

ui.inventory.shop.help:
Armory
BUY: Common bases of any class; search by name or filter by class.
SELL: your weapons for credits (the equipped one cannot be sold).
To upgrade, condense or fuse: the FORGE.
Pick a cell; the action button is in the detail on the right.

Trade workshop
Harvests and fish (never legendary; lowest value first) are condensed into trade materials to hire and upgrade helpers.
Pick a cell; the ×1 / ×5 / MAX buttons are in the detail on the right. Weapons and their materials are worked in the ARMORY.

ui.inventory.craft.help.group.change: CHANGE: turns the weapon into another type (e.g. axe → staff) and keeps whatever still fits.
ui.inventory.craft.help.group.improve: IMPROVE: changes the mods of this same weapon by spending materials. It doesn’t destroy any other weapon.
ui.inventory.craft.help.group.remove: REMOVE: deletes a mod from this weapon to make room for a better one. Costs credits.
ui.inventory.craft.help.group.transfer: TRANSFER: copies a mod, the passive or a skill from another of your weapons onto this one. The other weapon is destroyed.
